content.text: {"label":"unknown_demand_surge","explanation":"Payments volume is running about 47% above forecast all day (3021 vs 2057). Service level has collapsed to roughly 20-38% since 12:45, even with more agents than planned and AHT close to forecast, so staffing is not the problem. The excess is concentrated in refund_status (2.05x normal) and payment_status_enquiry (1.74x). There is no customer-facing incident, only a P4 internal email delay. Absences are at normal levels (3 vs 2.6 usual), so this is not a sick wave. The UPI cashback push is a possible driver, but offer-type signals are flat: new_offer_enquiry is 0.88x and upi_payment_failed only 1.36x. The evidence does not establish a cause, so I have labelled this an unknown demand surge. General is close to forecast but slipping, at 37% in the last interval, on AHT.","plan_name":"Payments surge containment 14:00-20:00","rationale":"The plan extends deflection, callback and coaching cancellation, which all expired by 14:00, and adds borrowed and paid capacity on payments. Chat deflection targets the two reasons driving most of the excess. IVR callback smooths the peaks. Cancelling coaching and delaying breaks for agents not already delayed recovers phone time. Overtime is limited to the remaining budget: about Rs 10,080 is already committed (about 8 and 6 accepted agents for 2 h each), leaving about Rs 4,900. Two offers of 8 agents each should bring about 3 accepted agents per offer, roughly 13 agent-hours or about Rs 4,600. No cross-skill move is proposed, because general is itself below 70% service level and cannot donate.
